subject.title: feat(gateway): pre-handshake WS verifyClient with Sec-Fetch-Site and forwarded-header hardening

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose these three `gateway.security.*` opt-in controls as the core Gateway contract for pre-handshake WebSocket admission, or should this work be narrowed or consolidated with the existing origin-policy direction?
rationale: The contributor has supplied final-head behavior proof, but deciding the supported security-policy surface and its relationship to Gateway origin controls requires owner intent rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve the scoped opt-in contract
options.body: Accept the three default-off controls as the supported Gateway security surface and proceed with normal final review.

options.title: Narrow or consolidate the policy
options.body: Ask for a smaller contract or alignment with the origin-policy work before accepting additional permanent configuration keys.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Accept the three default-off controls as the supported Gateway security surface and proceed with normal final review.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR timeline most strongly connects this person to the Gateway review and product-routing decision.
